name: b256_lr1e4
notes: Learning rate 1e-4 instead of 5e-5. Larger batches usually tolerate a larger step; 1e-4 drifted on the old batch of 128 without a teacher anchor (standing decision lr 5e-5), not tested with the anchor and rollout 256. Base recipe = the anchor recipe on the new default rollout 256 (start x_kickstart_best, rule bots + self-play, teacher jit8 KL 0.3 -> 0 by u300, w_wall 0.02, lr 5e-5), i.e. anchor_bigbatch (1700 over seeds 7 / 11 / 23, sd 10). Each variant runs on seeds 7 / 11 / 23 against the anchor_bigbatch run of the same seed. Trained on the MacBook Air, 2026-11-24. Judge by Elo and agf / aga after the ladder has settled.
